simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to מִכְלָאָה (H4356) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: מִכְלָאָה (miklâʼâh) means a pen (for flocks) First listed occurrence: Hab 3 17.

definitions.full: H4356. miklaah or miklah I. מִכְלָה (incorrect for מכלא ) noun [masculine] enclosure, fold ; — מִמּ ׳גָּזַר צאֹן Hab 3:17 ; plural construct צאֹן מִמִּכְלְאֹת לקח Psa 78:70 (object David); plural suffix מִמִּכְלְאֹתֶיךָ לקח 50:9 (object he-goats). — II. מִכְלָה see below כלה .
